label: First-party search-economy arm: extractor sound, code_node embed text too thin for NL recall evidence
title: First-party search-economy arm: extractor sound, code_node embed text too thin for NL recall evidence
summary:
Measured a fully first-party deliver-code arm (OUR lib/code-extract AST extractor -> OUR /overlay/code-nodes/bulk code_node layer -> OUR /search retrieval -> file:line snippet fetch) on the 13-query search-economy corpus, isolated daemon :8799 at main commit 0915d0c, workspace D:/zonoid-firstparty, scoped to lib/+routes/. Same locate-then-fetch metric as the other arms (top-6 located code_nodes, 12k char cap, recall = relevant-symbols-intersect-identifier-tokens, tokens = ceil(chars/4)).

EXTRACTOR IS SOUND: extracted 1168 symbols across 110 files (1104 lib, 64 routes), 0 parse failures; all 1168 ingested as code_nodes; every ground-truth symbol confirmed present in the index and fetchable by file:line.
